subject: They’re stepping aside — now what?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
60 members of Congress have announced they're not running for re-election. This is our chance to build something better.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260317-1&t=1&akid=3257%2E587540%2EjwG6Oy)
Peter,
Members of Congress are leaving the job at record rates.
Fifty-one House members and nine senators have announced they’re not running for reelection. That’s the most retirements across both chambers this century — and more Republicans are leaving than Democrats.
Some are retiring because of their age. Others want to tend to their families, and some have received death threats.
Yet more than ever, they are leaving because **they don’t like the workplace.**
Congress has become a toxic, frustrating place to work where nothing gets done.
**Rep. Jerry Nadler** put it perfectly when he announced his decision to retire: “Watching the Biden thing really said something about the necessity for generational change in the party.”
**[Peter, as the old guard steps aside, will you contribute $5 to Leaders We Deserve to help us elect young progressives ready to fill those seats?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260317_1_retiring.SSpG5E&refcode=em20260317-3257&amount=5&t=2&akid=3257%2E587540%2EjwG6Oy)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260317_1_retiring.SSpG5E&amount=5&refcode=em20260317-3257&t=3&akid=3257%2E587540%2EjwG6Oy)**
Right now, we have a choice.
We have the option to fill these seats with younger versions of the same broken politicians. **OR we can elect fighters who will actually stand up to Trump, reject corporate PAC money, and deliver for working families.**
We’ve already proven this can work. Christian Menefee was recently sworn into Congress. Zohran Mamdani is already delivering on his promises as mayor of N.Y.C.
These aren’t flukes. They’re the result of _good campaigns_ , which require organizing, grassroots fundraising, and true progressive campaigns that refuse to compromise.
The Democratic base is demanding new leadership. Even members of Congress are admitting the system is broken, and _now_ is the time to make it work.
**[If you’re ready to build something better, contribute $5 to Leaders We Deserve today.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260317_1_retiring.SSpG5E&refcode=em20260317-3257&amount=5&t=4&akid=3257%2E587540%2EjwG6Oy)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260317_1_retiring.SSpG5E&amount=5&refcode=em20260317-3257&t=23&akid=3257%2E587540%2EjwG6Oy)**
This isn’t just about age. It’s about electing people who understand progress isn't a straight line and that comfort doesn’t create change.
Sixty retirements? Sixty opportunities. Let’s elect the right people.
This is the fight we have to take on.
David Hogg

body:
But this campaign is built on something else.

| | | | |
---
Peter, St. Patrick’s Day is a good reminder that sometimes a little luck can help along the way. But the truth is, the things that matter most in life aren’t built on luck alone. Growing up in Columbia, I learned early that progress usually comes from something much simpler: hard work, grit, and showing up day after day for the people around you. That’s the mindset I’ve tried to bring to serving as mayor — listening to people when they call with a problem, working across differences, and doing the work of solving problems so our community can keep moving forward. It’s also the mindset behind this campaign. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_AjZeTJiEj26To-6e1vDhg~~/AAUS1hA~/ugUrQbjUIV_FgBaueRHNPeQQkr92KYf-IjCRrEsPp-ct445itFg5MRUdJ7DDFSTJtBcnp7TmbazF6zJ1piG1eepnfP4S2iGFR59S5lDY235IxSS-HjDHvJgdgKHeYK5sWdz2jZh0kR1GHe3h5rNjwgQ8zYOoKaW1Ze1hKZ6XXKiJAOzTjjNT7Hk6ldJ3i1Rr56hBEbNA7gLHYou1Z5ldSal7ku4dTCbMvJEOTMy0CU3LQfeXcPiWOiuOd1qChhc1) Because winning a race like this one isn’t just about luck. It’s about building something real — talking with voters across TN-5, earning trust, and putting in the work every single day. Unfortunately, my opponent has taken a different approach. Instead of focusing on the hard work of representing people in this district, he often leans on spectacle and Twitter tantrums to grab attention. It may create headlines or go viral online, but it doesn’t lower costs for families, strengthen our communities, or solve the real challenges people across TN-5 are dealing with every day. I believe Tennessee deserves better than that. This campaign is built the same way I’ve tried to lead as mayor: a little hope, a lot of grit, and a belief that steady work can still move our communities forward. [**If you’re able, will you pitch in $17 today to help us keep building this campaign across TN-5?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/9VcBxYouY2cqFqkmYUxlWQ~~/AAUS1hA~/qLkycf2TO7a0Y1YzD-YVS46GglWmAmiQ-0E5y4BHg2jocEYG6JZr-4FJI6uo7Npotf8mLB8-cwdIkKbzDmL-sK1dky8OQg_ADhfxOpM4NfH7YCnHcnpUVQ-2KxspBs8CA6qdPF1aqBPcmRXA6YgI_Ngp6F-BkT-ZSZCkXJy14fAOb6OZe5CKeRRbgrEO8ChzU3VbU3FVhcnhDeoJOcdmkMUkIgc9yMcxIZRJfYHCoAKD0JlacQ3dal9Pa-6lQod3Da91RxNMI7UGQEoLb8Q87g~~) | | [ CHIP IN](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/-e96DFMeSQCSRl9Z9gUKOA~~/AAUS1hA~/P66akLWIv97t_LeUc-nP9mkMVTaoHboMPv7ckV2Z2H7QbWwPZLmqQRX5PL4vsahio4FQ0bFHMENr-sfF84JU9zuA7G6A2HlTjXzXFS9GrO1cUB4PzSk63pBa8HM5aHMEM4E02n9JrB53zpEKGYzFzNloEMjXSCqfFPczZkVxtiudDoU8graxaYofoBPtWJmgsCsS-r_7nWzVq52ua9amENZbbPDnbc9dMrBuUeZ7a4_WBcKMVhxhMPv4A06HMI4t)

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Republicans are doing everything in their power to attack voting rights, and with the Senate ready to vote on the SAVE America Act THIS WEEK, we’re running out of time to fight back.

| | **Placer County Republican Party Unanimously Endorses Alexandra Duarte for State Senate**
---
| Placer County, CA — Alexandra Duarte, the conservative Republican candidate for California State Senate, announced the endorsement of the Placer County Republican Party, in yet another sign of her overwhelming support from conservative voters in the 4th District. The endorsement reflects continued momentum behind Duarte’s campaign and underscores confidence in her commitment to public safety, affordability, accountable leadership, and stronger representation for the communities of the district in Sacramento. It marks the third unanimous endorsement received by Duarte and a clear rejection of left-wing incumbent Marie Alvarado-Gil. Duarte continues to build a broader coalition of local leaders and Republican organizations united behind a message of common sense, community safety, and effective representation for working families and taxpayers. “I’m honored to have the support of the Placer County Republican Party,” said Alexandra Duarte. “This campaign is about ensuring that our region is represented by a strong conservative Republican.” Duarte is running for State Senate to crack down on crime, secure the border, defend parents’ rights, and make gas cheap again. ###

body:
#

Friend,
In just a moment, we’re going to ask you to add your name and join the thousands of others who have personally endorsed Mark Kelly. Please, give us a chance to explain why your endorsement is so important.
Over the last year, Mark has weathered a number of storms. Elon Musk called him a traitor. Roger Stone called for him to be executed. Donald Trump accused him of sedition and demanded his arrest and execution. Pete Hegseth threatened him with court-martial, demotion, and a reduction of his military pension. The Department of Justice tried to indict him.
None of those things stopped Mark. He continues to fight, and he’s able to do so because of this team. No matter what’s happened, you have had Mark’s back. For that, he is incredibly grateful.
Personally endorsing Mark might seem like a small act, but it speaks volumes about what we’re trying to do here. We are building something more resilient, more impactful than anything Trump has behind him.
That’s the truth.
[**And if you’re still a part of that team, please: Add your name and personally endorse Mark Kelly. He’s going to need you with him for whatever Trump throws at him next.**](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek-em-mar26-endorse/?source=em260317-1-f&akid=6393%2E6688874%2EmkcSRJ)

Thank you,
Team Kelly

Friend, During Trump’s second administration, the number of children in ICE detention has increased by _six times_. ProPublica interviewed families held in Dilley detention center in Texas, who said their children have become suicidal or have recurring nightmares every night. Some families have to pay to access clean water but have no money to do so. The food is contaminated, children are losing weight, and many have had medical emergencies. Last month, 4,000 nurses and doctors wrote to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), demanding the immediate release of all children in ICE detention. They warned that detention causes “predictable, severe, and lasting harm on children's physical and mental health.” Leaders in the American Academy of Pediatrics agree, and they’re also calling for children to be released from detention. [**Please sign on to demand Congress and the administration release all children from ICE detention now—and permanently shut down all detention centers.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9m5TwvEQAd8qR-4Y3cFoX07qDDE4_HVE6MY3e3bF63kNeqOeYTN-X_ZaIqS_umBfZosLQaXGQSfxD4ybm5RebygaLAK3fmgLcKDHdFNyuwt71UidHtXOgQhlv7TYweyVpVtIzJP-ZMVhj7pEqDGvv6k1rfYpTrsZ4tHfKm1cHENUHOq2uRS1s9Kcx6WkEdgXBIwKnLVlmtLcukPJoFG6-_qkR7bkJGNxzbq-GXQ_P7egGIV7q0asLZitrHcnJiOEWnJVZY2Ysg3-zrmnCkTsO_vOhFmSZopfXCzHk8ffTyF5_k7-VzG-ElSALIRkaWKOFvs3mjWYveWMGXhUFNcLpJ8HFrLrfAlTciQZWL34nBP0VB5gBXAw1_QkB43YDGhdKgR7d-RV6KzI1AvDGZovmh062VqhdvlKBFN8zF0oWKx5adEIRqXJ7BLNoaiy9TefKPtPKZRsVeyTRdBnshxBweJ4iYzOVjY2YzX8F7tL_Jn8/4p0/pB_PxBobRR2NuFraondfug/h1/h001.w_tAuWgSrsPSb9UIBCIb-O-mfwsJQatAy99lLOJn2pU) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9m5TwvEQAd8qR-4Y3cFoX07qDDE4_HVE6MY3e3bF63kNeqOeYTN-X_ZaIqS_umBfZosLQaXGQSfxD4ybm5RebygaLAK3fmgLcKDHdFNyuwt71UidHtXOgQhlv7TYweyVpVtIzJP-ZMVhj7pEqDGvv6k1rfYpTrsZ4tHfKm1cHENUz6OiVxvGcfTB8LZesP1ZqvyBMuY2hACKETJqwSde3aHA0-5cK9avV3BlCtKMc9UmFRyxM-1Y_ZnPZar4p4JnqJHZOa3lcZHyAn8JknvaL4VrsHo2N-rXNl9bjLO3nLIF95sSfgw3qLkuZV-UNeE23Vlt4t-lQqnY6gkteTCJe5L7Mxc4lLYwpwr7FyxPqSTAiaWWLcE575S7pkgEEPq11nbt1EHuVBibetgdOk6N2YtHWcEcofg_aKjHYfpz6WXwu_hCQG40ddAoAyIiJswY2CtfHoqqtQVNLdomG1Ym-UAriMYueqA9zWL__efD2qds/4p0/pB_PxBobRR2NuFraondfug/h2/h001.etvRcEEI_p_W3hbqA6KONzjOaRfQIwcYKVurWIBqFcE)

Like most immigration detention centers, Dilley is for-profit. It’s run by CoreCivic, a corporation that **makes more money when more people are locked up for longer**. On multiple occasions, visitors have heard children yelling “Let us out!”
These private companies are making record profits off violence and human suffering. They view us as potential profit, not human beings.
Already in 2026, twelve people have died in ICE custody—many from medical negligence, such as Emmanuel Damas and Alberto Gutiérrez Reyes. The latest is Afghan refugee Mohommad Nazeer Paktyawal, a 41-year-old father of six who risked his life while working with the U.S. military.
In January, staff at ICE’s Camp East Montana _killed_ Geraldo Lunas Campos, a father of four children. The ACLU documented systemic torture at the facility.
And in the past month, at least three people died soon after ICE and CBP (Border Patrol) agents dumped them outside, far from their homes—Irvin Cruz Nape, Nurul Amin Shah Alam, and Daphy Michel.
**We will keep saying their names. We will keep fighting back against ICE and CBP, including trying to block these agencies’ expansions into our communities.**
[**Will you sign the petition urging the federal government to shut down these inhumane and unconstitutional detention centers?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9m5TwvEQAd8qR-4Y3cFoX07qDDE4_HVE6MY3e3bF63kNeqOeYTN-X_ZaIqS_umBfZosLQaXGQSfxD4ybm5RebygaLAK3fmgLcKDHdFNyuwt71UidHtXOgQhlv7TYweyVpVtIzJP-ZMVhj7pEqDGvv6k1rfYpTrsZ4tHfKm1cHENUVH-4gWjzZvcJ8zpciGQ08nyHTjodUgL4q3O9MxWGC1v-hVJGkqhCycvff4QLPlm9ENHODSEqD3cI_GPsm1y0ycr5bIiTbiH_PPeCq8ksIlYvORGSQWDK_U5XDhMEqGvfyXmSlfNOHFt0jj8WJgjBfou687kU3pq2_PkWFSMlT7HjOZ8RhziDJyxTuhBQoyt1y2UI8bdLiwRJarmJVi-uAtkqptskjoJ3Ypq4PJRePo4ZMEZet4hlhoPmr7GragVhBaknz2qIUX6-7GpsQlpfdol4xLnDLsqj8EYFHk0cNeCTciGAhaKknW1y-UFQnMZ0/4p0/pB_PxBobRR2NuFraondfug/h3/h001.0jLYvaZ3plkI8BJufYwg65_K37P-pbduwAtxl5D1BKQ)

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9m5TwvEQAd8qR-4Y3cFoX07qDDE4_HVE6MY3e3bF63kNeqOeYTN-X_ZaIqS_umBfZosLQaXGQSfxD4ybm5RebygaLAK3fmgLcKDHdFNyuwt71UidHtXOgQhlv7TYweyVpVtIzJP-ZMVhj7pEqDGvv6k1rfYpTrsZ4tHfKm1cHENU-fWfqO5RXm9AE3caXzInbkl9qwwUVuue3CAx6l_szV3cbH6a7ivJoQ0nhvncc99O21Rm1qQgSrmLE6rHWdo4N7wmWrgOk8vgq6nQDWs6kPJno_14EkGCk_AjoPIehaP5wp33PehUQXSwDAvZMW7RD5VPM9ZDb7ZxNXz0-AT_i1N2-P4wK01yKGLvELEdCE2O8S4o5gjz_RGuTIwCc2McVV2gasFUOwC6iY8Xz9HxEl2186-kZ1aPADYdxh7cYhAUGP592BMA30c_MMsG8ulXtNfLvFJXgvNHpDQ8rjsIzvfPuBeeIvMoWbGEe-o3OdtY/4p0/pB_PxBobRR2NuFraondfug/h4/h001.pUfPjRS9pOW0x72vJOUAtD5XaXTMLvpXTvP7lM-LePQ)
**I’ve met with constituents sent to the North Lake detention center in Michigan, which is rife with abuses and run by the for-profit GEO Group.**
My team is also hosting Know Your Rights trainings with local groups, and I recently spoke at a local high school about protecting oneself and one’s family when interacting with ICE and law enforcement:
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9m5TwvEQAd8qR-4Y3cFoX07qDDE4_HVE6MY3e3bF63kNeqOeYTN-X_ZaIqS_umBfZosLQaXGQSfxD4ybm5RebygaLAK3fmgLcKDHdFNyuwt71UidHtXOgQhlv7TYweyVpVtIzJP-ZMVhj7pEqDGvv6k1rfYpTrsZ4tHfKm1cHENWz1Wwkqj_0bUId-iIyYx3GEqebEpvLU8i0aymq6kfIg_1OP-mk2_fHn5WjNIw2HGh1BGTqRl_iizQwdXWA44-DpGaMq8gXwR41wihZ_596J2J68fj63YvzwG2XYMmMdtjgnis2J_3BKvkYnwT_Ob-eEsPX454d0rwkHt1tA04sNGpJlS0fKG3r7LFLVdv0UnlVP7iMKVpYpYFHTPx6yl1gqrWISbIE3-cbKeHYahCNu_AjbsFIBYJDd9SnHGVVwBsEMDMYJ-3uBThA0vYSt2kaVHnLnv8xOyXtRbTKVTJt6_GqnmvJi8HzDtn4fvy02Tk/4p0/pB_PxBobRR2NuFraondfug/h5/h001.DcDZIfFYnEfwyL7CCOplSJRqVRj0bF29Joq83ayAA3U)
**About three-quarters of the people in immigration detention have not been charged with any crime.**
Like many others in immigration detention, Leqaa Kordia was following orders to come to an ICE office when she was arrested and trafficked across state lines.
**I recently traveled to Texas to visit Leqaa and call for her immediate release after a year in a for-profit detention center in Texas—and I’m glad to say our grassroots push to free her has worked!**
Leqaa was just released yesterday, after judges ordered her release three times.
The 33-year-old Palestinian American was held 1,500 miles from her home and her mother in New Jersey. At Prairieland detention center, her religious rights and human rights were violated. Denied medical care and the ability to sleep, she began suffering from malnutrition, which contributed to her first-ever seizure, after which she said: “I spent 72 hours chained like an animal in a hospital.”
When I visited her, we spoke about the inhumane treatment she and others experienced at Prairieland.
The lights are always on, which gave her migraines and made it hard to sleep. People are forced awake at 4 am, and the inedible food lacks basic nutrition. Pregnant women and sick people are mistreated and denied essential care. Although her unit was designed for 20 women, about 60 people are confined there in overcrowded conditions.
People have tried to take their lives there and in detention centers around the country. Staff at some of these places have even placed bets on who will die next. It’s sick, and it needs to stop right now. We must release everyone from these inhumane facilities.

We’re up against growing state violence, but together, we have power. We pushed Kristi Noem out of DHS leadership, and communities around the country have blocked warehouse detention centers. The state of New Mexico banned ICE facilities.

clean_body: No child belongs in ICE detention! We must release all children and shut down all detention centers. | | | Friend, During Trump’s second administration, the number of children in ICE detention has increased by six times. ProPublica interviewed families held in Dilley detention center in Texas, who said their children have become suicidal or have recurring nightmares every night. Some families have to pay to access clean water but have no money to do so. The food is contaminated, children are losing weight, and many have had medical emergencies. Last month, 4,000 nurses and doctors wrote to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), demanding the immediate release of all children in ICE detention. They warned that detention causes “predictable, severe, and lasting harm on children's physical and mental health.” Leaders in the American Academy of Pediatrics agree, and they’re also calling for children to be released from detention. | Like most immigration detention centers, Dilley is for-profit. It’s run by CoreCivic, a corporation that makes more money when more people are locked up for longer. On multiple occasions, visitors have heard children yelling “Let us out!” These private companies are making record profits off violence and human suffering. They view us as potential profit, not human beings. Already in 2026, twelve people have died in ICE custody—many from medical negligence, such as Emmanuel Damas and Alberto Gutiérrez Reyes. The latest is Afghan refugee Mohommad Nazeer Paktyawal, a 41-year-old father of six who risked his life while working with the U.S. military. In January, staff at ICE’s Camp East Montana killed Geraldo Lunas Campos, a father of four children. The ACLU documented systemic torture at the facility. And in the past month, at least three people died soon after ICE and CBP (Border Patrol) agents dumped them outside, far from their homes—Irvin Cruz Nape, Nurul Amin Shah Alam, and Daphy Michel. We will keep saying their names. We will keep fighting back against ICE and CBP, including trying to block these agencies’ expansions into our communities. In the metro Detroit area, I’m joining my neighbors and local lawmakers in pushing to cancel a new office lease to ICE in Southfield and block a planned warehouse detention facility in Romulus. I’ve met with constituents sent to the North Lake detention center in Michigan, which is rife with abuses and run by the for-profit GEO Group. My team is also hosting Know Your Rights trainings with local groups, and I recently spoke at a local high school about protecting oneself and one’s family when interacting with ICE and law enforcement: About three-quarters of the people in immigration detention have not been charged with any crime. Like many others in immigration detention, Leqaa Kordia was following orders to come to an ICE office when she was arrested and trafficked across state lines. I recently traveled to Texas to visit Leqaa and call for her immediate release after a year in a for-profit detention center in Texas—and I’m glad to say our grassroots push to free her has worked! Leqaa was just released yesterday, after judges ordered her release three times. The 33-year-old Palestinian American was held 1,500 miles from her home and her mother in New Jersey. At Prairieland detention center, her religious rights and human rights were violated. Denied medical care and the ability to sleep, she began suffering from malnutrition, which contributed to her first-ever seizure, after which she said: “I spent 72 hours chained like an animal in a hospital.” When I visited her, we spoke about the inhumane treatment she and others experienced at Prairieland. The lights are always on, which gave her migraines and made it hard to sleep. People are forced awake at 4 am, and the inedible food lacks basic nutrition. Pregnant women and sick people are mistreated and denied essential care. Although her unit was designed for 20 women, about 60 people are confined there in overcrowded conditions. People have tried to take their lives there and in detention centers around the country. Staff at some of these places have even placed bets on who will die next. It’s sick, and it needs to stop right now. We must release everyone from these inhumane facilities. Thank you for taking action! Your elected officials need to keep hearing directly from their constituents, whose tax dollars are being used to separate families and terrorize our neighborhoods. We’re up against growing state violence, but together, we have power. We pushed Kristi Noem out of DHS leadership, and communities around the country have blocked warehouse detention centers. The state of New Mexico banned ICE facilities. We will keep fighting to protect our neighbors, abolish ICE, and end the detention-deportation-industrial complex. And we will keep pushing for a new immigration system that’s just and humane. Everyone deserves freedom, and the movement for our collective liberation is growing. With you in the fight for dignity and safety for all, Rashida P.S. Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . Everywhere I go across Virginia, people tell me the same thing: costs are too high.
Groceries are more expensive. Housing is more expensive. Energy bills are more expensive. Families and small businesses are feeling squeezed.
Yet, instead of addressing Americans’ concerns, President Trump has doubled down on imposing universal tariffs that are raising prices even higher.
And let’s be clear — tariff is just another word for tax! He’s taxing the American people during a massive affordability crisis, and he’s breaking and bending the law to do it.
After the Supreme Court ruled that Trump’s previous tariff scheme was illegal, he immediately turned around and imposed a 10% tariff on most goods by relying on an outdated provision of trade law – one that has never been used in its 50-year history.
And now Trump is threatening to raise these taxes even higher.
That’s why I introduced the Reclaim Trade Powers Act, legislation that would repeal this outdated authority and stop Trump from using it to raise prices on American families.
Congress has the constitutional authority over trade, not the President. We cannot allow any administration to keep bypassing that authority to impose new taxes on Americans.
I’ve already led bipartisan efforts in the Senate to roll back several of Trump’s tariffs and to demand refunds for Americans after the Supreme Court struck them down, but this fight is far from over.
One way we can all fight Trump’s idiotic and illegal actions is to show overwhelming grassroots opposition. Will you add your name today to support my new legislation and fight against Trump’s tariffs? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/t6Kp8FBRWkeV8I98tPsySg2]

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Guilty as charged
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
My Republican colleague said I was making everything a “women’s issue.” It’s about time someone did.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260317-6018-footer&t=1&akid=6018%2E420207%2EXM2vFW)
Peter,
Recently on the House floor, I demanded accountability from the DOJ for its shameful failure to protect women. They’ve spent more energy protecting powerful men than they have delivering justice to the people who have been hurt.
**And my Republican colleague’s response? He accused me of making everything a “women’s issue.”**
You know what? You’re damn right I am.
When Congress debates health care, that’s a women’s issue. When we talk about immigration, that’s a women’s issue. When we fight over economic policy, wages, and workplace protections — guess what? That’s a women’s issue.
_And when survivors of sexual violence come forward and are met with skepticism, silence, or outright dismissal, that is absolutely a women’s issue._
When they dismiss something as “just a women’s issue,” they’re saying that women’s lives don’t intersect with the economy, with immigration, with justice. They’re saying that women’s suffering is a niche concern, and not one that is theirs to solve.
That’s how women wait decades for answers. It’s how powerful men stay protected, and it’s how injustice keeps breathing.
My Republican colleagues would love nothing more than for me to sit down and stay quiet. They’d love for us to treat survivors’ stories as an inconvenience. Or worse, a political talking point.
**I won’t. Not today, not ever.**
We owe it to women to hear their stories, and believe them. And they deserve representatives who will fight for them unapologetically and relentlessly, even when it makes the people around us uncomfortable.
**I can promise you today, Peter, that I won’t stop fighting until everyone gets the justice they deserve.**
But I can’t do this alone. My Republican colleagues will keep trying to silence me, and women everywhere, but we can’t allow them to drown out our voices.
[**Will you stand with me today and pitch in $3 to keep me in this fight?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260317-1.hS1WnA&refcode=em20260317-6018&amount=3&t=2&akid=6018%2E420207%2EXM2vFW)

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

| | | | | | Hi Peter,
**This is Senator Adam Schiff.** I’m writing today to proudly endorse my friend Nick Melvoin for reelection to the Los Angeles Unified School District Board.
You probably receive many emails like this from elected officials, so you likely want to know: why am I supporting Nick?
Nick Melvoin is a dedicated public servant who knows how to _**deliver results.**_
On the LAUSD Board, Nick has expanded early learning opportunities for young students, strengthened literacy, and improved student mental health services. He’s pushed for practical reforms that directly benefit families, including advancing a landmark cell phone ban, expanding workforce housing on district property, and increasing access to dental and vision services.
At a time when our schools need steady, outcome-driven leadership, Nick has proven he can govern.
Our party needs more next-generation leaders willing to step up and meet this moment, and **I’m proud to endorse Nick Melvoin for reelection.**

Hello Friends & Neighbors,

I hope you’ve been enjoying the spring weather that finally melted our historic snow!

Thank you for all of your advocacy and outreach during and after the storm. With such a historic snowfall (most recorded in RI history!), it’s good to take the opportunity to learn where we can do better going forward. We know that this has also led to some pretty historic potholes (I think I left my stomach in an especially deep one on Frost St). If a pothole has damaged your car, you might be eligible for reimbursement up to $300 from the City.

Big News: Ordinance Passed!****** With big thanks to all of our neighbors who advocated for this, I unanimously passed my ordinance on March 5th that reins in the process for when utilities tear up our roads and sidewalks for routine utility system maintenance. I heard from so many neighbors about roads left in disrepair, tools left on sidewalks and lawns, and no notice before construction began, leaving you trapped in your driveways.

The ordinance holds the utilities accountable and makes them implement some common-sense practices. When applying for a permit, the utilities need to provide information such as how they will notify residents within 48 hours ahead of tearing up a roadway, their plans for clean up at the end of the day, how they plan to coordinate with other utilities, etc. Failure to comply with their plan can result in a fine of $500/day per project.

Topics Being Discussed in City Council** **
Rent Stabilization:**

Thank you to the hundreds of people who have testified on our proposed rent stabilization ordinance.

We held an East Side listening session with over 3 hours of testimony. I also serve on the HOPE committee, where we heard another 6 hours of testimony and received nearly 1,000 letters. Also wanted to show gratitude for the folks who have reached out individually to share their stories, data, experiences, and studies with me directly over coffee or conversation.

I am listening, and many of us are committed to addressing the costs of rent for our residents in a way that will provide stability and predictability while also not impeding our focus on building new housing — both goals are possible together.

An amended version will be released in the coming days. With such a historic snowfall (most recorded in RI history!), it’s good to take the opportunity to learn where we can do better going forward. We know that this has also led to some pretty historic potholes (I think I left my stomach in an especially deep one on Frost St). I heard from so many neighbors about roads left in disrepair, tools left on sidewalks and lawns, and no notice before construction began, leaving you trapped in your driveways. The ordinance holds the utilities accountable and makes them implement some common-sense practices. When applying for a permit, the utilities need to provide information such as how they will notify residents within 48 hours ahead of tearing up a roadway, their plans for clean up at the end of the day, how they plan to coordinate with other utilities, etc. Failure to comply with their plan can result in a fine of $500/day per project. Yesterday, I filed over 18,000 signatures to officially get on the ballot in Virginia.

I’m asking voters to rehire me because the work is not done. I just came off five days of traveling across Virginia, and what I heard was enormous frustration and concern. Costs are out of control, from health care, to housing, to child care and utility bills. Our country is getting propelled into another war of choice in the Middle East. The job market is shifting beneath our feet.

_And the president doesn’t seem to have a plan. He doesn’t even seem to care. And his administration is in over its head._

**But it’s not lost on me, we have to do more than just stand against President Trump. We’ve got to have a positive vision to bring the country back together:**

It’s time for us to no longer try to simply patch our old health care system. We need universal health care.

We need to be ready for the amount of change brought by artificial intelligence. There will be good things, but we’ve got to ensure we don’t have massive job dislocation coming out of the AI transformation.

We’ve got to stand up for America’s critical role in the world, and we need somebody that can work with folks across the aisle to find common ground and restore our leadership on the world stage.

We’ve got to find ways to bring energy prices down, which means ending Trump’s assault on renewable energy.

We need to address the housing crisis by encouraging rehabilitation of existing structures, speeding up permitting, and making it easier for first-time homebuyers to obtain their first mortgage.

The path forward will not be easy but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight.

**I’m going to campaign this year – as I always have – by getting out on the road, talking to voters face-to-face, telling them about my record, and most importantly showing them what I’ll do if I get rehired.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127528438/608362783/1037320630?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MyPlan_260317_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWM1NDlhYS01MzIyLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IcD2nq6bVdOaXkSSQZ_3dFK2AgDwF40tlGADEzqKyqE=) Getting on the ballot was the first step, but the next few weeks will be hugely consequential to the outcome of November’s election. We’ve got many investments to make in voter outreach, dozens of trips across Virginia to plan, and hundreds more volunteers to recruit.

[_**A donation made today to our campaign is an investment in the future we’re building together – and it truly couldn’t come at a more important time for our campaign or our country. So I’m humbly asking, if you’re in a position to donate today, will you help me officially kick off my reelection campaign with a donation right now?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127528439/608362784/1037320630?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MyPlan_260317_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWM1NDlhYS01MzIyLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IcD2nq6bVdOaXkSSQZ_3dFK2AgDwF40tlGADEzqKyqE=)

The fight continues,

Mark Warner **Before you go:**

We’re asking people like you – who care deeply about our democracy and the future of our country – to join us in our fight to help Democrats win the midterms and bring accountability and transparency to Washington.

[_**Will you contribute today to reelect Mark Warner, support Democrats in races across Virginia, and flip control of Congress?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127528440/608362785/1037320630?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MyPlan_260317_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWM1NDlhYS01MzIyLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IcD2nq6bVdOaXkSSQZ_3dFK2AgDwF40tlGADEzqKyqE=)**__********[Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127528441/608362786/1037320630?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MyPlan_260317_T1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWM1NDlhYS01MzIyLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IcD2nq6bVdOaXkSSQZ_3dFK2AgDwF40tlGADEzqKyqE=)**********

_The result has been some of the most important original journalism we 've published. Important enough that David Shuster is now following her work with his own reporting. That's what happens when someone is doing it right. **The story gets bigger, not smaller.**_

* * *
_**by David Shuster**_
There are few spectacles these days in America more predictable than the reflexive absolution that MAGA world and most conservatives grant to Donald Trump. Accuse Trump of anything--fraud, corruption, or the mistreatment of women--and his defenders respond with speed and certainty. They insist the facts are irrelevant, the accusers are presumed liars, and the matter is settled before a single document has been read.
Against this background of ignorance, Ellie Leonard's recent Substack investigation into the Epstein files "Jane Doe #4" stands out -- precisely because it does the unfashionable and meticulous work of examining records instead of slogans.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/579a6441-b783-41f6-97e1-8600abaaad02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Leonard's comprehensive report digs through investigative material related to Jeffrey Epstein's trafficking network and highlights several things that should give all of us pause: a woman told federal investigators in 2019 that she was trafficked as a minor, introduced to powerful men, and allegedly raped by Donald Trump in the 1980's. The FBI interviewed the woman four times. Investigators found her credible. And her credibility has now been bolstered by documents, business records, and other materials not in the Epstein files.
Let's start with the basics. Jane Doe #4 told the FBI she met Jeffrey Epstein in the 1980's in Hilton Head, South Carolina through a baby sitting service and was eventually abused by Epstein and then, in NYC, raped by Donald Trump.
* * *
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=191201079&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkxMjAxMDc5LCJpYXQiOjE3NzM3OTA2ODUsImV4cCI6MTc3NjM4MjY4NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.LhZdL-wdCWtXJOYC5op47SFNyp1xtXiphvC9UrxCH-I)
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f79323d0-c63c-4ac7-b8cb-c925193ace3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In her 2019 interviews, Jane Doe #4 detailed to the FBI where she lived in South Carolina and beyond, her mother's embezzlement convictions, her own bouts with drugs, divorces, and legal problems. She was transparent and hid nothing. And now, the mundane details Jane Doe #4 gave the FBI and detailed in the Epstein files have been corroborated.
As for the incendiary high profile allegations, Jane Doe #4 spoke to the FBI about being taken to NYC and sexually assaulted by Donald Trump.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f79323d0-c63c-4ac7-b8cb-c925193ace3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As was reported weeks ago by several news organizations citing the document above released in the Epstein files, Jane Doe #4 alleges in one incident that she bit Trump's penis and Trump responded by punching her in the head. Beyond the alleged abuse, Jane Doe #4 gave the FBI other details about Trump. She knew, for example, he had illegal building permits. Jane Doe also told the FBI she had confided in a friend in the 1980's about Epstein and Donald Trump. The friend corroborated these assertions to the FBI.
* * *
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=191201079&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkxMjAxMDc5LCJpYXQiOjE3NzM3OTA2ODUsImV4cCI6MTc3NjM4MjY4NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.LhZdL-wdCWtXJOYC5op47SFNyp1xtXiphvC9UrxCH-I&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
Naturally, when the Department of Justice posted some of the FBI interview reports about Jane Doe #4, Trump partisans responded in their usual way: they attacked the witness, reporters, and anyone else within shouting distance. This ritual has been perfected over the past decade. Every woman who accuses Trump is declared unstable, dishonest, or politically motivated before her story is even examined. The accusation itself becomes proof of malice.
But this Trump strategy gets increasingly absurd when placed alongside Trump's actual legal record.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f79323d0-c63c-4ac7-b8cb-c925193ace3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In 2023, a civil jury found Trump liable for sexual abuse and defamation in the case brought by writer E. Jean Carroll. That verdict established a remarkable fact in American history: a U.S. president was adjudicated liable for sexual abuse.
The Jane Doe #4 story of alleged rape in the 1980's matters because it places Trump within the dark orbit of Jeffrey Epstein's trafficking operation earlier than previously acknowledged.
* * *
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_._e_8E45veiB6rgI1aTbHMuV5hUSS4kNvQfC9Z4KNusY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=191201079)
* * *
Jane Doe #4 also matters because she establishes that Trump allegedly acted in a pattern. While Jane Doe #4 alleges Trump raped in the 1980's, a separate accuser known as Katie Johnson alleged that Trump raped her as a minor in the 1990's.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f79323d0-c63c-4ac7-b8cb-c925193ace3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Johnson pushed forward with a lawsuit in 2016 and then dropped it just before the 2016 presidential election.
Within that context, the reporting in Ellie Leonard's Substack report can not be dismissed. Here we have yet another Epstein survivor who told investigators she was trafficked to powerful men and raped by Donald Trump Trump. The FBI found Jane Doe #4 credible. And there are still 37 pages from the FBI interview documents of Jane Doe #4 that are still being withheld.
It raises the obvious question: why are those documents being withheld? What other evidence might still exist that Attorney General Bondi has not released?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f79323d0-c63c-4ac7-b8cb-c925193ace3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *

These are the sorts of question that Trump's defenders keep trying to bury. Their method is simple. Instead of examining the record, they attempt to discredit anyone who dares to mention it. The accuser must be lying; the reporter must be biased; the old newspaper microfiche must have been doctored; the entire subject must be taboo.
But journalism, at its best, performs the opposite function. It insists on dragging uncomfortable facts into the daylight. Ellie Leonard deserves credit for doing exactly that--patiently assembling fragments of investigative history that many Americans would prefer remain scattered and forgotten.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f79323d0-c63c-4ac7-b8cb-c925193ace3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Whether Jane Doe #4's trafficking and rape allegations against Donald Trump, Jeffrey Epstein, and Ghislaine Maxwell are ever proven or disproven is ultimately a matter for evidence, corroboration, and law. What cannot be denied is that her testimony exists, the FBI considered it important enough to document repeatedly, and details provided to the FBI and released in the Epstein files have now been corroborated. In other words, Jane Doe #4 was credible when she spoke to the FBI in 2019 and her credibility remains intact in 2026.
That reality alone punctures the fairy tale carefully cultivated around Donald Trump: the notion that every accusation against him is an obvious fabrication and every accuser is a political operative.

In truth, the pattern looks very different. Again and again, women have come forward with sexual abuse allegations against Donald Trump. Again and again, his defenders have responded not with inquiry but with fury. And again and again, the public has been urged to forget the matter entirely.
Relentless and fact based investigative reporting is a crucial antidote to that amnesia. By examining the record surrounding Jane Doe #4, we have been reminded that rape allegations against Donald Trump will not vanish simply because his supporters object loudly on cable tv news or because the mainstream media refuses to take a closer look.
If anything, a more troubling possibility has emerged: that the full history of the sexual abuse Donald Trump inflicted has yet to be told.
For those invested in protecting Trump's reputation, that prospect is intolerable. For anyone interested in the truth, it is precisely why the work must continue. And thanks to the painstaking and exhaustive investigative journalism of Ellie Leonard and others, that work carries on.

And Two-Dollar Tuesday
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260317-2622)
Peter,
There’s a lot of negativity in the world. For this week’s Two-Dollar Tuesday, I wanted to focus on some things that make me feel hopeful.
**Our neighbors.** Blizzard Elsa knocked out power for 170,000 households, shut down roads and closed schools. And across the state, Wisconsinites showed up — snow-blowing each other's driveways, opening warming centers in Sheboygan, staging Red Cross shelters for stranded drivers. No one waited to be asked.
**The courts are fighting back.** Federal judges keep blocking this administration's overreach — on tariffs, on immigration, on the independence of the Federal Reserve. And right here in Wisconsin, ten companies are suing for refunds on the $3.5 billion our businesses paid in illegal tariffs last year.
**We keep winning.** Progressive candidates have won 18 of the last 23 statewide races in Wisconsin since 2017. Fair maps are finally in place. Democrats have a real shot at flipping the state Senate this fall.
**This campaign.** Last night we held a virtual meetup with dozens of our Super Volunteers — and I asked them what keeps them going. They talked about building community and believing we can build something bigger and better for this state. These are people giving their time, their energy — because they believe Wisconsin is worth fighting for. They're right.

_Every great artist had to start somewhere._
Dear Valued Subscriber and Movie & Music Lovers,
Did you know that **Garth Brooks** faced significant rejection early in his career? Reports indicate he was turned down seven times by record labels before finally securing a deal with **Capitol Records** in 1988.
Lynn Shultz of Capitol Records heard him perform at the Bluebird Cafe in Nashville in August 1988. After that performance, a meeting was arranged, and he was signed shortly after -- leading to his debut album in 1989.
Garth has since sold over 170 million records worldwide, establishing him as one of the best-selling music artists in history. In the United States, he is the top-selling solo artist with over 157 million certified albums, surpassing Elvis Presley and ranking only behind The Beatles in total sales.
**[Vote Now in the Heartland AwardsTM ->](https://substack.com/redirect/a5defc9b-5ece-49fa-8851-d8ac7aad8d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Did you know that at age 11, **Taylor Swift** was rejected by every major label in Nashville, Tennessee, when she first shopped her demo tapes? Later, at 14, she walked away from a development deal with **RCA Records** because they wanted to "shelf" her until she was 18 -- choosing instead to sign with the start-up label **Big Machine Records**.
As of late 2025, Taylor Swift is the highest-certified female album artist in U.S. history, with over 110 million album-equivalent units certified by the RIAA. Her 2025 album _The Life of a Showgirl_ broke records with 4 million equivalent units in its debut week and continues to lead sales in 2026.

Dear Valued Subscriber and Movie & Music Lovers, Did you know that Garth Brooks faced significant rejection early in his career? Reports indicate he was turned down seven times by record labels before finally securing a deal with Capitol Records in 1988. Lynn Shultz of Capitol Records heard him perform at the Bluebird Cafe in Nashville in August 1988. After that performance, a meeting was arranged, and he was signed shortly after -- leading to his debut album in 1989. Garth has since sold over 170 million records worldwide, establishing him as one of the best-selling music artists in history. In the United States, he is the top-selling solo artist with over 157 million certified albums, surpassing Elvis Presley and ranking only behind The Beatles in total sales. Did you know that at age 11, Taylor Swift was rejected by every major label in Nashville, Tennessee, when she first shopped her demo tapes? Later, at 14, she walked away from a development deal with RCA Records because they wanted to "shelf" her until she was 18 -- choosing instead to sign with the start-up label Big Machine Records. As of late 2025, Taylor Swift is the highest-certified female album artist in U.S. history, with over 110 million album-equivalent units certified by the RIAA. * * *
Israel Takes Out Iran Leaders

Israel says it killed Ali Larijani, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council and widely considered the regime's [de facto leader](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGuozAQRb8GOiN7gACFi23SZdst0cQeJ6OYMbK9sPv3T7xPeN3Vle7V0fnzWB_IkeX1Gzey7uDVJ79mllQyPSniC1lKrW8qeBCuoOGmdK_MtEpcTeut87ceWrJmmvppXgwM7dsu42zIhzAAeI-9Q9SjWQieIxq3jEvL9nrSvZmgN6ChGwPpGeCpg5sCjXMz6L-7x0qlc0kK5QMrH8Qi6UpJOpe2Ntp3rXtp-l8N3Bu4n-fZhfRP6Lxm29WkHH0D95p2xRmFUVQKgR1jVC5tG4qnrD4cI3lVauYPKS4ZKSpPgaSQ2li4VMqq4P_SZuv3k2PkcpuaQb825PgNU3_g77DwFQAA__-LyoPB), in an overnight strike carried out with U.S. intelligence support. Defense Minister Israel Katz confirmed the strike also [took out Basij commander](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHOpCAUhZ9GOwxcHHEKim3sZtstzRUu400QJsDoPv7GfYS_O6c450u-P6_1hRw5vX_jQdadvPrs18Ip10IbRXwjp9raThVPwhUkTEJqocya4qp6b52fNPRklTHazE8FY79bLZ2Zt_AAaeYpoBq920aa51E_IYwIPdv7SWplQCuQMDwCyRlgk8GZQI-5G-X347FRHVxOlcqJjU_ilPKdchpcPvpo99Y-tdO_Olg6WK7rGkL-m-i6Z0cHS-STxN07WL5VcMEkuBakKC4sIt6EJg4sbhdq6ov1n4tj5DqZbpTvAzn-J7UfyDkt_AsAAP__MAt0yw) Gholamreza Soleimani, the man who oversaw the brutal crackdown on Iranian protesters. Larijani is the highest-ranking official killed since the opening salvo that took out Ayatollah Ali Khamenei on Day One of Operation Epic Fury. Tehran has not confirmed the deaths. Prime Minister Netanyahu said Israel is ["undermining this regime"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGO5CAQRL8GZ4yg8QzegOASsr30QqsNzUyfMIyAtXV_f_J-wmYVPFWV3p_P9RM5c3n-xp1cOHiNNa6NS-2NNsr4RC59jBd1PAhXUPCQykht15JXPUUX4sPARE5ba-zyoWGeXg7VouOHsmDv2iRIQCrecZ4X2pakQ5rYXU3KaAtGg4LbPZFaADaVgk10X8Ssvt4RB_VbqKVTO3DwQVxKvVItt1D3KbvXGO8uzC8BXoA_z_O2NeKxYRsXIcCXbxyz7BS-Go9_Avw1LsArI8BrK8Bzb0hZhoy8dzmqfOFBkjLvXHBQlNywdBlJJgyjykwYqUnMLDM2_ouFBfipufg-OWfuDytm9dyR8_fR8QO3h4P_AQAA__8L9Inn) to give Iranians "the opportunity to take their destiny into their own hands." ★★★
Cuba Goes Dark, Trump Eyes Takeover

Cuba's entire national power grid [collapsed Monday](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLEO3CAQRL_G7jjBcjaXgiLNdZc2pYVhsVdagwWcyedHziekG400o6f3-7N8HDGl7Zc70PqLlpDDUijlWnBFdpujVFvbsboL3QISZiG1UGZJvKgxWB9mDSNaZYw2rx8KnuNu1QzK6EmDAx-naVImwBxXhRAiRB9HsveT1MqAViDhMUWUL4BVRm8iTq_hKb9ncA3rw-dUsVyu0YWUUr5TTg-fj5Ht3tpZB_1zgPcA7977I-Y_Cfs9O-4mFw4DvP13dVVgalRQIKNvhbxjsRUKwmdmd1asgtFdlDbR98woqLJLQXRqe_42ceaOZSw2nJ2Yqc5meMrtcMT_YNp_-Lss_A0AAP__GMqDgQ), plunging all 10 million residents into darkness -- the third major blackout in four months as the Trump administration's oil blockade chokes off fuel shipments. President Trump told Fox News senior White House correspondent Peter Doocy he believes he'll have the ["honor of taking Cuba"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL_upCAURp9GOwx_VPwVFNvYzbZbmgtc9WYQDDC68_abmUfY7jTfl5Pz57E8gALF7TccaNxFi09-yRRTyWgxwAYUS607FrgQFsnlyLhiQi8xLKL1xvlRyRaN0Frp6UfIvt3NoEfuR9VbaQfb82EC7cQ06eGnF71Qa0vm88SV0FIJyWU3rMgnKS1fnV5xmJqev04PFUvnUiyYL6h0IcWYPpRi59LRBrPXepZG_Wrk3Mj5vu9uTX8j3p_Z0cj5TIEqudLIuebXcbIC78J2ZBYD4YVf3qGwPcWUWYUnxY25lwXmIITCHGSyFiEyKgGiZxfmN7sRnhjRs_iVabPx500hUBl10_PtAApfw_ofUS8j_wUAAP__Ha-J9A), calling the island a "failed nation" with "no money, no oil, no nothing." Cuba's deputy prime minister announced the government would allow [Cuban exiles to invest](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LGOtCAUBeCngc4JXFSYguJv7OZvtzQIV70ZBCPoZt9-4zzCdic5OV9xvl7jy1GktPx3G1p_0RhyGA9KuRw4YXSLo1RqXbG4C90IAvpGqEbqMcVR8mB96BVwtFJrpc1TQstXa2YDUrSdR-W9NPI5P1WQvu9kkF0IipO9JaGkBiVBwKObURiAScxez9gZ1opzD65ieficCh6Xq3QhpZTvlNPD541Hu9a6F6b-MRgYDHXFlWK8OwbDniP5HwYDpYpH-sxcZDB02vRGmqYe57Y31b0pLY0_J9dM0fl3PiuDgR827N8UI5Ves1Ysm6OPzOsfjros_AYAAP__VZJ4Jw) in companies on the island -- a radical concession from the communist regime. President Diaz-Canel confirmed Friday that Havana is in talks with Washington. ★★★
Kent Quits, Trump Says "Good"

National Counterterrorism Center Director Joe Kent [resigned Tuesday](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGOtCAURp9GOwxeHNGC4m_s5m-3NAgX5yYIBu7oPv5m9hG2-5rvnOR8PdenpUhp_28PNO6i1We_Fkq5Ftww2t1SqswvrPZCu4KEUUgler2muPatN86PClo0vdZKT3MPQ_syTgU7OudDGGa_aaU2kNM8yRCUkyHMLZkPSapeg-pBQvcIKCeATQanAz6mZpDv01vG2rmcKpbLMl1IKeXPyqlz-WijeTGftVH_GlgaWO777kL-Tnh_bkcDy5kjMbnawML5FC6_E2NhLCUXqofIIZAjG0XBSnuq4iyZsbJ4V3HbIqjY1Bbjz5tipDrqZpD7YSn--vkPyS4DPwEAAP__ns9_wA) in protest of the Iran war, calling it unjustified and blaming Israeli pressure for dragging the U.S. into the conflict. Kent, a Gold Star husband and 11-tour combat veteran, is the first [senior Trump official](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LFuwyAUheGnwVssuBAgA0MXb-na0cJwSa6EITIU9_Gr9BG6neV8w_91X--eMpXHp9_RhUFrrHE9qNR24IbZPzyV1vsTmx_oV-CgL1xehFlLXsUUXYhawoROGCONvQlQ09NFIVQS3OpN-RSS9lebdFBKSsX55m8TubfEpTAgBXCYrwm5Bdh4Cibh1TLFv1_Rd2xzqKXhMXyngVRKfa9a5lD3Kbtn76_G5AeDhcFynuec6k_B833bGSyDIlYGi5Y3wQ1YaYWA6XDxdVLO1LRhij92T_kP7P9oMBz8BgAA__9rg2mi) to quit over the war. President Trump dismissed him from the Oval Office, saying it's a "good thing" he's out. A senior administration official told Fox News Kent was a ["known leaker"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LFuwyAYBOCngY0IfmxjDwxdvKVrRwvD7_hvCFhAXPXtq-QRup10p2-4r-tydRQp3T7dA60_aQk5LIVSrgVXjO7mKNXWdqzuRLeAhEFILZRZUlwUD9aHQQNHq4zRZpwUdHy3clunKfTbKLWEsE6dWsdVoxoA_TB0mpN9SVIrA1qBhEu_oRwBVrl5s2E_sk4-j-Aa1ovPqWI5XaMTKaX8SjldfH7waPfWjsr0B4OZwdx23CnGV8dgTu-hi6KifxZqvwzm3ozGTFK0p79jEd6VWHMSR3FUsYrvjOKOqTGYebHh-KEYqQ6GdfL2cPSWefvHUaeFvwAAAP__eZ94bA) who had been cut out of intelligence briefings months ago and played no role in Iran planning. The Marin County Green Party has formally endorsed Rose Penelope Yee for U.S. Congress in California’s 2nd District

| | | | | [|
---](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=4975d9d672&e=8c53948e4c)
| | | | | |
# Wearing Green Today
---
| | Hi Friends,
Today is St. Patrick’s Day, and everyone is wearing green! Like St. Patrick, my campaign is here to drive the 'snakes' of special interests out of our government.
And what better day than today to share with you that our campaign is officially**endorsed by the Marin County Green Party**.
Although I am a proud Democrat, I wholly welcome their support! Our People, Peace, and Planet platform closely aligns with core Green Party principles, including ecological wisdom, social justice, grassroots democracy, and nonviolence.
**Do you want to be represented by a candidate who is willing to cross party lines, work with organizers and activists on the frontlines of democracy, and build a coalition that will make the Democratic Party stronger? If you do, can you send a small donation today to ensure our campaign message reaches everyone in District 2?**
---
| [Click here to chip in what you can. Every dollar helps!](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=b9119f76f3&e=8c53948e4c)
---
| | The Marin County Green Party cited our campaign’s consistent opposition to endless war and domestic militarism, our focus on redirecting public resources toward healthcare, housing, climate-resilient infrastructure, support for main street businesses, and our commitment to democratic participation and community-led governance as key reasons for their endorsement.
The cross-party endorsement underscores my campaign’s broader coalition-building approach and the belief that effective representation means listening to and governing with the people most impacted by policy decisions.
**I am running to represent California’s 2nd District with a vision that is bold, honest, independent, and truly grassroots.**
Onward for People, Peace and Planet,
Rose Penelope YeeCandidate for Congress, CA-02

name: Justin J. Pearson
subject: Tell Congress: no more blank checks for war
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Committee to Elect Justin J
body:
We can’t let Iran become our next “forever war.”
| [ ](https://jj-p.org/l/g0VYDrnzLaKN?t=ITXx9NQPGv6N)
---
Peter, we can’t let Iran become our next “forever war.”

_And_ we cannot keep letting presidents treat war like it’s a personal decision they can make on a whim, then ask the rest of us to live with the consequences.

**Only Congress has the power to authorize and declare war.** _Not_ the White House. And _not_ any single person.

But right now, too many members of Congress are ducking that responsibility and handing Trump a blank check. A blank check for escalation. A blank check for endless conflict.

[Add your name now to join our Movement’s petition and tell Congress: enough is enough. No more blank presidential authority to wage and launch endless wars.](https://jj-p.org/l/GwQgRjVaTSXg) | [SIGN THE PETITION →](https://jj-p.org/l/aa3jpwTNwymF)
---
**We've seen what happens when Congress looks away, Peter.**

After 9/11, vaguely written authorizations and political pressure opened the door to decades of war in Afghanistan and Iraq. Countless lives were lost. Trillions spent. And here at home, the People who needed help were told to wait, while the same politicians found unlimited money for bombs.

Now Trump is openly talking about how we could be fighting Iran for “a while.”

**But here’s the thing:** “A while” eventually turns into years. Years can turn into decades. And the ones who pay the price are never the folks holding press conferences.

This isn’t about being weak or strong. It’s about being wise. It’s about refusing to allow ourselves to be lied into _another_ open-ended conflict, while our communities are struggling with **real emergencies _every day:_** high rents, low wages, closed hospitals, poor schools, and basic dignity being treated like a luxury.

The GOP’s mission is clear to us. They want chaos overseas to distract us from the fact that they’ve done __nothing__ to make life better for working People. War becomes the smokescreen. And our lives become the afterthought.

**Unless we do something about it.**

[Peter, it's time for Congress to do its job. That’s why I’m counting on you to sign our petition right now and demand they stop handing out blank checks for war.](https://jj-p.org/l/MH2Sqe1zFaEM)
[SIGN THE PETITION →](https://jj-p.org/l/rLdd5mpZ8uD1)
---
